div.div:
Steps
1. Control plane tenant
GitLab-managed GovCloud system of record.
2. Customer job plane
FIPS runners and self-hosted AI stay outside.
3. Unauthorized egress
Commercial Duo gateway and public runners.
4. AO signature boundary
Letter covers control plane evidence, not every job host.
